title: Liriodendrin exerts protective effects against chronic endometritis in rats by modulating gut microbiota composition and the arginine/nitric oxide metabolic pathway.
authors: Cheng, Fang; Li, Dan; Ma, Xijia; Wang, Yami; Lu, Luyan; Hu, Bin; Cui, Shuke
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨中药成分Liriodendrin对大鼠慢性子宫内膜炎的保护作用，涉及肠道菌群和代谢通路，仅含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic endometritis (CE), a gynecological disease, is characterized by inflammation. Liriodendrin is reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. However, the therapeutic effects of liriodendrin on CE and the underlying molecular mechanisms have not been elucidated. This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic effects of liriodendrin on CE in rats and the underlying mechanisms. METHODS: A CE rat model was established and administered with liriodendrin for 21 days. The serum levels of inflammatory cytokines were examined using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. The uterine mRNA levels of cytokines were examined using quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction analysis. The activation of the Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)/NF-kappaB pathway was investigated using western blotting analysis. The effects of liriodendrin on intestinal flora and serum metabolites were examined using 16S rRNA sequencing and untargeted serum metabolomics, respectively. The protein and mRNA levels of arginase-2 (Arg-2) and the nitric oxide (NO) metabolic pathway-related factors were assessed. Molecular docking was performed to explore the interaction between liriodendrin and Arg-2. RESULTS: Liriodendrin alleviated the CE-induced pathological changes in the uterus, modulated the serum levels of inflammatory cytokines, and downregulated the mRNA and protein levels of TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway-related factors. Treatment with liriodendrin mitigated the CE-induced upregulation of Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes ratio and Lachnospiraceae abundance and downregulation of Ruminococcaceae abundance. Serum metabolomic analysis revealed that liriodendrin regulated the biosynthesis of choline metabolism pathway-related factors. Liriodendrin suppressed the CE-induced upregulation of Arg-2 and downregulation of inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) expression, and NO levels by directly binding to the amino acid residues of Arg-2 through hydroxyl bonds. CONCLUSIONS: Liriodendrin exerted therapeutic effects on CE in rats through the alleviation of inflammation by modulating the gut microbiota structure, directly downregulating Arg-2, and regulating the arginine/NO metabolic pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性子宫内膜炎（CE）是一种以炎症为特征的妇科疾病。据报道，里里奥苷（Liriodendrin）具有抗炎特性。然而，里里奥苷对CE的治疗效果及其潜在分子机制尚未阐明。本研究旨在探讨里里奥苷对大鼠CE的治疗效果及其潜在机制。方法：建立CE大鼠模型，并给予里里奥苷治疗21天。使用酶联免疫吸附测定法检测血清中炎症细胞因子水平。使用定量实时聚合酶链反应分析检测子宫中细胞因子的mRNA水平。使用蛋白质印迹分析研究Toll样受体4（TLR4）/NF-kappaB通路的激活。分别使用16S rRNA测序和非靶向血清代谢组学检测里里奥苷对肠道菌群和血清代谢物的影响。评估了精氨酸酶-2（Arg-2）和一氧化氮（NO）代谢通路相关因子的蛋白和mRNA水平。进行分子对接以探索里里奥苷与Arg-2之间的相互作用。结果：里里奥苷减轻了CE诱导的子宫病理变化，调节了血清炎症细胞因子水平，并下调了TLR4/NF-kappaB通路相关因子的mRNA和蛋白水平。里里奥苷治疗减轻了CE诱导的Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes比率和Lachnospiraceae丰度上调，以及Ruminococcaceae丰度下调。血清代谢组学分析显示，里里奥苷调节了胆碱代谢通路相关因子的生物合成。里里奥苷通过直接与Arg-2的氨基酸残基形成羟基键结合，抑制了CE诱导的Arg-2上调、诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）表达下调以及NO水平变化。结论：里里奥苷通过调节肠道菌群结构、直接下调Arg-2以及调节精氨酸/NO代谢通路来减轻炎症，从而对大鼠CE发挥治疗效果。
